svg.title: A charged day in Gothenburg, 2013-02-08
svg.desc: The ten passages of a car on 2013-02-08 in Gothenburg on the tariff of the day, the five 60-minute single charge windows they open, each charging its highest fee (SEK 8, 13, 18, 18, and 13), the free passage at 18:35 that opens none, and the SEK 70 of the windows capped at the daily maximum of SEK 60.
